message: No detected input validation: The code reads pickle files and graph data directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local directory ('datasets_runs/') with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; there is no remote source handling at all.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected label set, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples on the graph features or training data before passing them to the model.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates GAT/SpGAT models from scratch and trains them; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, so no integrity verification (hash, signature, pinned revision) is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is plain Adam with no DP-SGD wrapping, and neither Opacus nor TensorFlow Privacy nor any other differential privacy library is imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress testing anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test indices come from the same graph object used for training, there is no cryptographic signing or hashing of evaluation data, and the code even passes idx_train twice (as both train and val) in train_pipeline, indicating the test split is not strictly isolated from the training process.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads graph files and processes them directly with no shape, range, or schema validation before passing features and adjacency matrices to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are consumed directly via argmax (max(1)[1]) and passed to sklearn metrics with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a Graph Attention Network (GAT) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
